source_text: Lex arietis pro delicto; sancta sanctorum. Delictum occultum lucem quaerit. Ariete Christus solvit.
pass_a_gloss: Law of-ram for offense; holy of-holies. Offense hidden light seeks. With-ram Christ looses.
pass_b_english: This is the [[law of the ram for guilt; it is most holy >> Bible:Leviticus 7:1]]. Hidden offense seeks light. Christ looses by the ram.
